{{TournamentPageStart|twitchid=lcs|toclimit=2|text=The '''LCS 2024 Spring Season''' is the first split of the eleventh year of North America's professional League of Legends league. Eight teams will compete.}}

==Overview==
=== Format ===
* 8 teams participate
* Double Round Robin
* Matches are best of one
* Top six teams qualify for [[LCS/2024 Season/Spring Playoffs|Playoffs]]
** Top 4 teams start in the upper bracket
** 5th and 6th start in the lower bracket
